<a id="init_screens"></a>
### [`init_screens`](../../../../src/init/init_screens.asm#L21) `$8D11`

*routine*

Copies both charsets from $5000 and $5fe8, builds bitmap rows 19-24 from $68E8, makes the sprite bar and sets seven expanded sprites in a row.
